{{Top|leg}}
An '''Initializer core''' was a component of a [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler's]] reactor core. Without it, the reactor could not be brought online.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] hid an initializer core from the [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] [[Sligh]], [[Grees]], and [[Emala]], believing that doing so would prevent them from reactivating their salvaged sandcrawler.<ref name="TG" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''
